Name: Green's redesigned horse
Author: GreenJellyblob
Description:
Alright! Now it has 6 different solid colors! The default one, the brown one (a bit warmer than the default), blonde, white, grey and black! I probably won't be adding more colors for quite a while, there are other mods I wish to work on.

Sadly, HATS STILL DON'T WORK with this horse version!

One day I might figure out the coding necessary to fix that, but for now, this horse will have the hats stuck to its neck in side view.

Downloads.Description: Now it has 6 colors! Readme has details on changing the horse's color
